claim_boundary: No product-superiority, SOTA, revolutionary, replacement, validation, or held-out claim is permitted unless an exact-SHA v5 admission artifact passes every frozen gate.

candidate.ingestion: Identical blind structural units and source order to v4. No answer, gold, scorer, validation, or final field is readable by compilation or selection.
candidate.atomic_batch: Validate the persisted chain once under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; reject duplicate IDs within the batch or against persisted state; construct the same ordered per-event SHA chain in memory; insert all event rows with one executemany call; COMMIT once; on any exception ROLLBACK and restore the in-memory chain exactly.
candidate.evaluation_storage: Store shadow units only in the scientific event log. Production index record count must remain zero. Production recall remains fail-closed.
candidate.segmentation: Numbered fact; line-start Document N section; otherwise non-empty blank-line paragraph; official chunk only when no structural boundary exists.
candidate.reconciliation: Highest source-order parsed value per normalized subject-relation key; explicit deletion is a retrieval-ineligible tombstone with retained provenance.
candidate.retrieval: Deterministic query-token IDF; exact entity seed plus at most four active graph links for claims; at most twenty units under frozen budgets; ties by source recency then memory ID.
candidate.production_promotion: 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound strictly greater than zero, at least five independent clusters, three reproducible runs, and zero false verified promotions.

allowed: MemoryAgentBench units labeled development in the frozen split manifest
MemOps subjects labeled development in the frozen evaluation split manifest
STATE-Bench development learning trajectories already prepared without validation/final execution
development_scope.candidate_changes_after_development_outc: A changed mechanism requires a new protocol version and digest; thresholds and admission gates may never be weakened.

development_gate.cluster_identity: content or subject fingerprint; repeated rows with the same fingerprint are one cluster
development_gate.absent_intervention_policy: A row with zero selected memories or byte-identical treatment/control prompts is invalid for uplift estimation and must be reported, not coerced to zero effect.

terminal_rule: If the frozen v5 candidate does not pass the development gate, report failed_experiment_v5 and create no validation, held-out, admission, SOTA, or revolutionary claim. Public WaveField descriptions and WaveMind Connect remain unchanged.
